output.subject: Your new debit card's tap-to-pay
output.body:
Dear ⟦CUSTOMER_NAME_1⟧,

Thank you for calling us about your new debit card. You told us that tap-to-pay hasn't worked anywhere you've tried it, although paying with the chip works normally. We understand how inconvenient it is when a new card doesn't work the way you expect, especially at the checkout.

Our notes from your call show that a replacement card was ordered for you during the conversation, at no fee. We know that what you want most is a debit card you can rely on, with contactless payments working as they should.

We have passed your concerns to our Card Services team, who will review them. We will respond within 10 business days. If the replacement card arrives and tap-to-pay still doesn't work, or if anything else comes up in the meantime, please let us know so the team has the full picture.

Thank you for your patience, and we're sorry for the frustration this has caused.

Kind regards,

Customer Care, Meridian Harbor Bank
notes_for_analyst: Confirm the replacement card was actually ordered and that no fee was charged, as the call note states.
Decide whether to give expected delivery timing or activation guidance for the replacement card.
Check whether contactless is enabled on the current card and whether the fault suggests a card defect or a settings issue.
Decide whether any further action is needed beyond the replacement already ordered.
